name: Josh Anderson
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years building subscription, billing, and payment platforms, event-driven backends, and multi-region distributed systems, primarily in Elixir. Leads projects from discovery to production with cross-functional teams, most recently the monetization platform behind every onX subscription.

experience.blurb: GPS navigation and mapping apps (Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, Fish) for millions of outdoor adventurers.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Domain

highlights.text: Built the Stripe purchasing APIs behind web express pay (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Stripe Checkout, intro offers, coupons) and the non-app-store purchase option on iOS and Android, directly increasing profit margins on every onX subscription.

Architected and delivered the refactored system of record for purchases, payment profiles, memberships, and entitlements (Elixir, Phoenix, Oban Pro, PostgreSQL, GCP Pub/Sub), from discovery through phased GA, while also delivering new features (Toyota and Ford partnerships, OxR SOS integration). It now handles 100% of subscription read/write traffic company-wide.

Led the backfill of legacy purchase data from five gateways (Apple, Google, Stripe, redemptions, trials) into a modernized schema, using batched Oban Pro workflows across separate data stores, and reached 99.999% reconciliation accuracy on historical transactions.

highlights: Designed and implemented the Stripe purchasing engine: payment intent endpoints, webhook handlers, and 12+ orchestrated workflows covering the full membership lifecycle (purchase, renew, upgrade, crossgrade, downgrade, resume, cancel, expiration).
Championed Oban Pro as the core event-driven job-processing architecture, using its dynamic concurrency control, durable workflow composition, and multi-cluster distributed processing.

Drove end-to-end observability of the platform for GA readiness: custom OpenTelemetry distributed tracing of Oban Pro workflows, structured GCP logging, Grafana dashboards, and Prometheus and Sentry alerting.
Integrated downstream systems through Pub/Sub pipelines and CDC feeds, retaining full integrity of analytics, user traits, and notifications.

Provisioned backend infrastructure through Atlantis Terraform PR automation, including multi-region CockroachDB scaling and GCP secrets management, and owned weekly cross-functional rollout communications to leadership.
Led early adoption of AI-assisted engineering, integrating Claude, Codex, and Copilot into developer workflows.

experience.blurb: Online travel booker and software company building community and trip-planning tools.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer, Squad Lead
highlights: Achieved 99.99% uptime across core systems processing $1B in hotel bookings annually.
Cut average hotel rate search response from ~10s to ~3s, saving an estimated 800+ hours of combined search time daily.
Led a team of junior developers building an in-house CMS for real-time hotel content overrides.
Contributed to the rebuild of the core hotel bookings engine, from a Ruby on Rails monolith to an Elixir umbrella app.
Built a resilient data collection system for metrics and reporting on AWS Kinesis, Lambda, and Snowflake.
Migrated the in-house image service to Cloudflare Images CDN, improving delivery speeds for 3.2M+ hotel images.
Added AI image moderation, classification, and sentiment tagging with AWS Rekognition and OpenAI Assistants.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Developed and patented "Assembler", which normalizes thousands of provider mappings into 79,000+ standardized hotel records.
Designed and maintained content import and delivery pipelines (Golang, Elixir, PostgreSQL, GraphQL), and took imports from monthly and weekly release cycles to daily scheduled jobs.
Bulk-migrated standard hotel records to a refactored schema with zero critical errors or data loss.
Improved observability with DataDog, Honeybadger, and Splunk.

roles.title: Software Developer
highlights: Led the migration of multiple microservices to AWS Lambda, contributing in part to a 25% reduction in overall tech spend.
Collaborated on re-architecting the content pipeline with Docker and Terraform, and mentored junior developers.

roles.title: Junior Software Developer
highlights: Assisted in migrating hotel search to AWS CloudSearch, and added CloudFront CDN support to the image service.
